info.description:
A self-hostable platform for city governments to run common civic services.

Staff endpoints require a Bearer JWT from the configured OIDC provider.
Citizen endpoints (marked "public") do not require authentication.

**Development**: set `DEV_DISABLE_AUTH=true` in .env to bypass JWT
validation locally. Remove before production deployment.
info.title: Fieldstone Civic Services API

get.description:
Returns a paginated, filterable view of the immutable audit log.
All filter parameters are optional and combinable.

get.description:
Returns the city-registered JSON Schema (draft-07) for the given resource
type. Used by DynamicMetadataForm and by permits/requests/records to
validate metadata on every write.
get.summary: Get the custom field schema for a resource type

404.description: No schema registered for this type

put.description:
The request body must be a valid JSON Schema document (draft-07). This is
an idempotent upsert — calling it again replaces the previous schema.
Changes take effect immediately; the 60-second cache in domain services
means active requests may use the old schema for up to one minute.
put.summary: Register or replace a custom field schema

get.description:
Returns the staff user record matching the JWT subject claim.
In development (DEV_DISABLE_AUTH=true) returns a synthetic dev user.
Secrets are never returned after creation.

post.description:
Registers an HTTP endpoint to receive Fieldstone events. The secret is
shown once in the response and never returned again — store it securely.
Event patterns use NATS wildcards: * (one token), > (all remaining).
